title: Retrieve crystal structures
action: Obtain crystallographic data (atomic coordinates and lattice parameters) for Li₂CO₃, Na₂CO₃, K₂CO₃, and LiKCO₃ from published literature or open databases.
description: The structures are needed as input for DFT calculations.

title: DFT ground‑state calculation
action: Perform self‑consistent DFT calculations for each compound using an appropriate exchange‑correlation functional (e.g., LDA) and a plane‑wave or numerical atomic‑orbital basis. Produce converged charge density and Kohn‑Sham eigenstates.
description: Generates wavefunctions and eigenenergies needed for all downstream analyses.

title: Band structure and density of states
action: Compute the electronic band structure along high‑symmetry directions and the total density of states N(E) using symmetrized Fourier interpolation or equivalent post‑processing.
description: Post‑processes the DFT output to obtain band dispersions and the total DOS.

title: Extract quantitative band properties
action: From the band structure and DOS, determine the widths of valence‑band bundles I, II, and V, and the fundamental band gaps for Li₂CO₃ and Na₂CO₃. Write the results to band_properties.json.
description: JSON file containing band widths and band gaps. Only Li₂CO₃ and Na₂CO₃ are required for scoring; the other two compounds may be omitted.
output_schema: Object with keys for each compound: Li2CO3, Na2CO3, K2CO3, LiKCO3. Each value is an object with fields: band_I_width_eV (number), band_II_width_eV (number), band_V_width_eV (number, optional), band_gap_eV (number).

title: Optical function calculation
action: Compute the imaginary part of the dielectric function ε₂(E) for all four compounds using momentum matrix elements or an equivalent method. Output a CSV file with energy and ε₂ columns.
description: CSV with columns: Energy_eV, eps2_Li2CO3, eps2_Na2CO3, eps2_K2CO3, eps2_LiKCO3. Energy range 0‑20 eV, step ≤0.1 eV. Missing entries for compounds not computed may be filled with 0.0.
output_schema: Table with columns: Energy_eV, eps2_Li2CO3, eps2_Na2CO3, eps2_K2CO3, eps2_LiKCO3. Energy in eV, step ≤0.1 eV covering 0‑20 eV. Missing entries may be filled with 0.0.
